reports.title: Water levels at Stampede Reservoir continue to decline as fall progresses
reports.text: Smallmouth bass fishing has slowed considerably with cooler temperatures, and the bite is expected to remain slow for the rest of the season unless warmer weather returns.

reports.title: Water temperatures continued to fall, with fishing remaining good overall
reports.text: Spotted bass were caught in 10 to 30 feet of water on drop shots, Ned rigs, and small jigs, with dark green, brown, Aaron’s Magic, and Smoke Shad among the productive colors. White bass responded to spoons, inline spinners, and tail spins, while crappie held near submerged structure and responded to mini jigs, small swimbaits, and live minnows.

reports.title: Fishing was good at Hart Park last week
reports.text: Fishing was good at Hart Park last week, with largemouth bass caught on Senkos, Texas-rigged plastics, and jigs near the inlet and floating weed beds. Baby bass, brown, and orange crusher were productive colors, while topwater lures produced surface strikes after dark.
